description:
RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0 - Slaying Kuldra! The New Raid! Tonight we’re diving back into the Scorned Wilderness and taking on Kuldra in the new RuneScape: Dragonwilds raid. We’ll be progressing through the Scorned Wilderness, fighting through the raid, testing our builds, chasing loot, and seeing if we can bring Kuldra down again.

RuneScape: Dragonwilds 1.0 introduced the Scorned Wilderness, new enemies, Rune gear, Dragon gear, Ancestral equipment, Black Dragonhide, new weapons, and the Kuldra raid encounter, so there’s still a ton to explore and learn.

If you’re playing Dragonwilds 1.0 and working your way toward Kuldra, the Scorned Wilderness, or endgame progression, come hang out, ask questions, and see how the raid goes live.
